items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was in Milt’s band: Joe Diorio on guitar and myself, and he had bass, drums, and piano, and Mickey Lynn was the singer

ctx.x: And you were just backing him?
Yeah, they do comedy. I was in Milt’s band: Joe Diorio on guitar and myself, and he had bass, drums, and piano, and Mickey Lynn was the singer, a real beautiful woman, and himself.
